variations.title_en: Rising high, on the Jupiter side
variations.reading_hi: Jeevan rekha upar Jupiter ki taraf se uthti hai — mahatvakanksha aapke jeevan ki steering hai. Self-control zabardast hai; aap apni zindagi goals ke hisaab se chalate hain, mood ke hisaab se nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate IX position 4, p.41

drawing.note: The life line beginning high, on the Jupiter side (start y under 0.3, lines.ts:741), drawn on the thumb side of its corridor so its start stands clear of the heart line's end.

variations.reading_hi: Jeevan rekha neeche Mangal kshetra se uthti hai — jawani mein gussa tez aur zid pakki. Umra aur anushasan ke saath yahi aag aapka fuel ban jaati hai. Trigger points pehchano, react karne se pehle 10 second ruko.

sources.loc: Ch.III, Plate IX position 5, p.41

drawing.note: The life line begins lower, from Mars: it starts 0.12 along its corridor (y about 0.33), under the head line's start.

variations.reading_hi: Aapki jeevan rekha apna raasta chhod kar poori tarah Chandra parvat ki ore beh gayi hai — jeevan ek lagataar safar hoga. Ek thikane par basna mushkil, aur parampara ke anusaar aapka sthayi ghar janmabhoomi se door kisi aur desh/pradesh mein banega. Pakka pravaas yog — NRI wali kismat.

sources.loc: Ch.XIV — Life line sweeping to Luna: continual travel, settles far from birthplace; end-of-life clause excluded per safety policy

drawing.note: The lower end swings out toward the Moon: at the wrist the line runs to the palm-side edge of its corridor, past the palm's midline (x > 0.5, lines.ts:742).

variations.reading_hi: Jeevan rekha lambi, gehri aur bina rukavat ke hai — majboot jeevan-shakti, achhi rog-pratirodhak kshamata aur mazboot constitution ka sanket. Aapki energy ka tank bada hai; use sahi kaam mein lagao. Jab life line strong aur clear ho, yeh Mars ki shakti ko darshata hai — himmat, dridh irada aur jasaadat ka sanket hai. Aisa vyakti aksar apne lakshyon mein sthir rehta hai. Yeh ek achha sanket hai jo aatma-bal ko favour karta hai. (2 classical sources is baat par sehmat hain.)

qualified.text_hi: Jeevan rekha jo gehri, saaf aur achhe rang ki ho, yeh sanket deta hai ki vyakti ka swaasthya aur urja achi tarah se tikhi rehti hai. Aksar yeh log sharirik roop se mazboot aur bimariyon se door rehte hain. Yeh ek shubh sanket hai jo aapki samarthya ko darshata hai.

Jab Mars line Life line ke saath milkar saaf aur gehri dono lines dikh rahi hain, toh yeh ek dohra suraksha kavach ki tarah hai jo aapki urja aur fortitude ko badhata hai. Is combination mein aapki Life line ki har acchi cheez aur bhi strengthen ho jaati hai. Yeh sthayi nahi hai agar aap apna khayal rakhen toh yeh energy aur bhi nikharta hai.

Jab jeevan rekha ek sundar angle banaate hue liver rekha ki taraf jhukti hai, toh yeh ek tez, samajhdar aur sthir swabhav wale vyakti ka sanket deta hai. Aisi logon mein business sense aur quick decision lene ki khoobiyan aksar payi jaati hain. Yeh ek bahut hi shubh sanket hai un logon ke liye jo vyapar ya kisi profession mein naam banana chahte hain.

variations.reading_hi: Jeevan rekha kadi-jaisi (chained) hai — energy ke utaar-chadhav aur pachan/thakan par dhyan dene ka sanket. Yeh bhavishya ki sazaa nahi, sirf body ka manual hai: neend, khana aur recovery ko priority banao, tank bhara rahega.

variations.title_hi: शुक्र पर्वत के चारों ओर अखंड अर्धवृत्त
variations.reading_hi: Aapki jeevan rekha bina kisi shakha ke Shukra parvat ke chaaron ore saaf ardh-vritt banati hai — jeevan mein sthirta ka yog. Badlaav aur bhatkav kam, apni mitti apne log zyada. Ghar, community aur jadein — yahi aapki taqat hai. Duniya ghoomne walon ko aakhir mein wapas aisi hi zindagi chahiye hoti hai jo aapke paas pehle se hai.

variations.title_hi: मस्तिष्क रेखा पर रुकती उठती शाखा

Sabak: bade decision par doosri raay lena aapke liye luxury nahi, zaroorat hai.

Yeh sthayi character nahi hai — is par gaur karke is par kaam kiya ja sakta hai aur apne nazariye ko wider banaya ja sakta hai.
